Ultimate Space Kit by Quaternius

License: CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain)

Only the models the game uses are copied here (alien trees, rocks, plants, two robot enemies), FBX as shipped.
Textures/Atlas.png is the colour atlas embedded in the pack's glTF files (the FBX files reference it but the FBX download does not ship it).
